verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce is infrastructure for external AI agents: UCP MCP servers, a CLI, and an AI Toolkit plugin for third-party assistants such as Claude. The natural-language skill in docs-13 runs inside the user's own external assistant, not a built-in one. The 'spin up your store from a simple prompt' marketing line is an adjacent store-setup feature, not a documented in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to. A built-in assistant is a fair question for this kind of SaaS platform, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence of one.
